Seedance 2.5 Prompt
SEEDANCE 2.5 — BLADE SHERIFF vs. POLICE GREMLIN — THE GOLD VAULT

Duration: 30 seconds.
Aspect ratio: 16:9.
Style: photorealistic live-action action-thriller with a dry comic payoff. Realistic skin, leather, fur, gold, weight, and cinematic motion blur. Bright, luxurious golden lighting throughout.

Action movie camera work continues every 1 second.

Give every one-second interval a motivated cinematic camera movement. Adjacent intervals may continue the same shot; preserve geography and screen direction.

REFERENCE LOCK

Reference image 1 = BLADE SHERIFF only:
One 188 cm adult man, the exact reference face, swept-back brown hair, beard, black sunglasses, long dark leather trench coat, black shirt, tactical trousers, harness, and black leather engineer boots. One reference-matching revolver in his right-side holster. Maintain his identity and proportions throughout.

Reference image 2 = POLICE GREMLIN only:
Approximately 80 cm tall, enormous triangular ears, purple and pink fur, red eyes, uneven fangs, clawed hands and feet, a long furry tail, a blue police cap with red trim and gold badge, and the reference uniform shoulder patches/armbands. Preserve the reference anatomy and costume.

There are exactly SIX gremlins: one original sentry plus five identical-looking reinforcements. All six use reference image 2, remain approximately 80 cm tall, and retain separate bodies and consistent positions. No additional creatures.

Use both character sheets only for appearance. Do not show their layout, labels, diagrams, or backgrounds.

LOCATION AND CONTINUITY

One enormous bank vault, brightly illuminated by golden ceiling lights. Tall steel shelves packed with neatly stacked gold bars flank a spacious central aisle. A closed briefcase sits on a waist-high central pedestal. An already-open circular vault doorway is visible at the far end.

The original sentry patrols beside the pedestal, initially looking away from the hero's approach. Five reinforcements crouch out of sight behind low gold stacks at the shelf bases.

The hero descends behind the sentry's sightline, lands, disconnects from the rope, and approaches the briefcase. The rope stays behind him near the landing point.

Use shared frames to show the 188 cm hero towering over the 80 cm gremlins. The hero's right hand handles the revolver and later flicks the cap; his left hand carries the briefcase.

The gremlins' extreme sound sensitivity is a fictional creature trait. Their oversized ears reveal both their detection ability and their eventual weakness.

SECOND-BY-SECOND ACTION AND CAMERA

00–01:
Extreme macro on the original sentry's gigantic furry ear. It sharply TWITCHES at the very first instant. A rapid, precise push-in catches the flexing cartilage and individual hairs.

01–02:
Pull back in a low lateral arc to reveal the small sentry in the huge golden vault. Its long tail sways as it keeps watch beside the central pedestal.

02–03:
Crane and tilt toward an open ceiling vent behind the sentry. BLADE SHERIFF silently descends on a taut rope into the aisle.

03–04:
Track downward beside his descending body. His long leather coat hangs with realistic weight; the sentry remains turned away in the background.

04–05:
Push close to his sunglasses. Bright gold shelves and ceiling lights glide across the lenses. He remains intensely focused.

05–06:
Tilt down with him as both boots gently meet the floor. He disconnects from the rope and takes a silent, careful step toward the pedestal.

06–07:
Glide beside his extended right hand as it approaches the briefcase handle without touching it. A subjective heartbeat grows louder and faster.

07–08:
Rise into an extreme close-up of his brow above the sunglasses. One bead of sweat gathers, stretches, and detaches. The heartbeat intensifies.

08–09:
Track the single droplet down to the polished floor. It strikes with one unnaturally distinct, close-miked TIK. The heartbeat cuts off immediately.

09–10:
Whip-pan to the original sentry's ears. Both ears pivot precisely toward BLADE SHERIFF. The camera creeps around toward its newly alert eye.

10–11:
Continue the creeping arc as the sentry slowly turns toward him. Its alert expression becomes a mocking grin, exposing its uneven fangs.

11–12:
Slide laterally across the shelving gaps as FIVE reinforcements rise from crouches behind low gold stacks. Heads, caps, and huge ears emerge in an ominous coordinated reveal.

12–13:
Lift into a clear overhead view: exactly SIX gremlins form a ring around the single hero, with the pedestal just beyond his reach. Establish every attacker's position.

13–14:
Drop to gremlin height and sweep along the ring as all six bare their fangs and ROAR together. The hero stands at the center, dwarfing them.

14–15:
Pull rapidly into a wide, low view as all six crouch, extend their claws, and launch toward the hero simultaneously from their established positions.

15–16:
Enter brief slow motion. Orbit partway around the hero as all six attackers converge through the same physical space, claws leading, ears spread, tails trailing.

16–17:
Track tightly around his right side as he sweeps his coat backward and draws the revolver. The airborne gremlins remain visible beyond the moving coat; the draw is clear and continuous.

17–18:
Tilt sharply along his arm as he points the revolver STRAIGHT UP at the reinforced ceiling. The attackers close in. A tiny moment of near-silence precedes the shot.

18–19:
He fires EXACTLY ONE SHOT upward. Show one muzzle flash and one recoil, with a small distant ceiling impact. Snap to a wide view as a transparent, refractive pressure front expands from the gun through the golden room, bending reflections and lifting fine dust. Return to real-time motion with the report.

19–20:
Punch in on the original sentry as the sound reaches it. Its huge ears fold backward and ripple; its smug expression instantly turns to stunned panic. It grabs both ears and shrieks.

20–21:
Track across the other airborne attackers as they also cover their ears and lose coordination. Their claws stop reaching for the hero. The same single gunshot reverberates through the vault.

21–22:
Low lateral tracking follows the first three gremlins tumbling and sliding onto the floor. Gold bars rattle on their shelves; a few shift and clink, without a shelving collapse.

22–23:
Continue the motion into a wider view as the remaining three land and collapse in a staggered sequence. All six are now down, alive and dazed, clutching their ears. The hero remains upright.

23–24:
Push toward the hero as he calmly lowers the revolver and returns it to the same right-side holster. The original sentry still has its police cap.

24–25:
Track his LEFT hand lifting the closed briefcase cleanly by its handle from the pedestal. The last heavy echoes fade into small metallic rattles.

25–26:
Dolly backward in front of him as he strolls toward the already-open vault doorway, carrying the briefcase in his left hand. His coat swings with each measured step.

26–27:
Move to a low side angle. Beside his path, the original sentry weakly props up its upper body while remaining down on the floor, cap crooked. The hero briefly bends at the waist and knee, bringing his free right hand within natural reach.

27–28:
Tight tracking close-up of ONE casual right-finger flick against the cap brim. The cap pops off and spins away. He immediately straightens and continues walking.

28–29:
Follow the spinning cap down to the floor. It lands, the metal badge gives one tiny CLINK, and the cap settles beside the defeated sentry.

29–30:
Glide into a final close-up of the sentry's exposed ear, which reflexively twitches at that tiny clink. Rack focus to BLADE SHERIFF walking through the open vault doorway in the background, briefcase in hand. End on his unhurried departure and the sentry's humiliated reaction.

SOUND

No BGM, no rhythmic music, no musical stingers, no dialogue, no narration.

Use only environmental and action sound effects:
Faint ventilation, restrained leather movement, the rising subjective heartbeat, the single exaggerated sweat-drop impact, claws scraping metal, six creature roars, coat swish, revolver draw, ONE deep concussive gunshot, layered reflections of that SAME shot, nonverbal creature shrieks, falling bodies, rattling gold, the briefcase handle, measured boot steps, and the final cap-badge clink.

The heartbeat is a subjective tension effect, not a noise the guard hears. The sweat-drop impact is the detection trigger. Make the gunshot feel powerful through contrast and reverberation, without clipping or distortion.

CONSTRAINTS

Preserve the specified action order and the ear-weakness payoff. Slow motion is limited to the converging leap and the draw; keep the rest purposeful and moving.

The one bullet goes upward into the ceiling. The six gremlins are overwhelmed by the fictional sonic effect, not struck by bullets.

No blood, wounds, dismemberment, deaths, extra shots, lasers, magic beams, glowing energy rings, lightning, fireballs, room collapse, or additional combat moves.

No extra people or gremlins, changing scale, swapped costumes, fused bodies, duplicate heroes, floating weapons, teleporting props, or changing briefcases.

Keep the original sentry's cap on until the final finger flick.

No animation, illustration, comic rendering, subtitles, captions, title cards, added logos, or character-sheet text. Preserve the costume emblems visible in the reference.

Seedance 2.5 提示词
SEEDANCE 2.5 — 刀锋警长 vs. 警察小恶魔 — 金库

时长：30 秒。
画幅比例：16:9。
风格：照片级真实实拍动作惊悚片，带有干巴巴的喜剧式收尾。真实的皮肤、皮革、毛发、黄金、重量感与电影感运动模糊。全片采用明亮、华丽的金色灯光。

动作片摄影机调度，每 1 秒持续推进。

为每一个一秒区间安排有动机的电影化摄影机运动。相邻区间可以延续同一镜头；保持空间地理关系与屏幕方向一致。

参考锁定

参考图 1 = 仅刀锋警长：
一名身高 188 cm 的成年男性，与参考图完全一致的面容、后梳棕色头发、胡须、黑色墨镜、长款深色皮质风衣、黑衬衫、战术裤、战术背带，以及黑色皮质工装靴。右侧枪套中放置一把与参考图一致的左轮手枪。全程保持其身份特征与身体比例。

参考图 2 = 仅警察小恶魔：
身高约 80 cm，巨大的三角形耳朵，紫色与粉色毛发，红色眼睛， uneven 不齐的獠牙，带爪的手脚，一条长毛茸茸的尾巴，一顶带红色镶边与金色徽章的蓝色警帽，以及参考图中制服上的肩章/臂章。保持参考图的解剖结构与服装。

共有六只小恶魔：一只原始哨兵加上一看完全相同的五只增援。六只都使用参考图 2，身高保持约 80 cm，彼此身体分离、位置一致。不得出现其他生物。

两张角色设定图仅用于外观参考。不得展示其排版、标签、示意图或背景。

场景与连续性

一座巨大的银行金库，由金色顶灯明亮照亮。高大的钢制货架上整齐堆满金条，夹着宽敞的中央通道。一个合上的公文箱放在齐腰高的中央基座上。远端可见一扇已经打开的圆形金库门。

原始哨兵在基座旁巡逻，最初背对主角的接近方向。五只增援蹲伏在货架底部低矮的金条堆后方，不在视线内。

主角在哨兵视线之外下降、落地、解开绳索并接近公文箱。绳子留在原处，靠近着陆点。

使用共享画面表现身高 188 cm 的主角俯视身高 80 cm 的小恶魔。主角的右手操作左轮手枪，之后弹飞警帽；左手提公文箱。

小恶魔极端敏锐的听觉是虚构生物特征。它们过大的耳朵既体现了侦测能力，也暴露了最终的弱点。

逐秒动作与摄影机

00–01：
极近微距拍摄原始哨兵那只巨大的毛茸茸的耳朵。它在最初一瞬间就猛烈抽动（TWITCHES）。一次快速精准的推进镜头捕捉到软骨弯折与单根毛发。

01–02：
以低位弧线拉远，揭示小小哨兵身处巨大金色金库之中。它在中央基座旁站岗，长尾巴左右摆动。

02–03：
升降机镜头并俯仰，移向哨兵身后敞开的天花板通风口。刀锋警长（BLADE SHERIFF）沿绷紧的绳索无声降入通道。

03–04：
沿他下降的身体向下跟拍。他的长皮质风衣垂坠出真实重量感；哨兵在背景中仍背对着。

04–05：
推近至他的墨镜。明亮金色货架与顶灯在镜片上滑过。他始终高度专注。

05–06：
随他一起下摇镜头，两只靴子轻柔落地。他解开绳索，向基座迈出无声而谨慎的一步。

06–07：
在他伸出的右手旁侧滑行，右手靠近公文箱提手但未触碰。主观心跳声越来越响、越来越快。

07–08：
上摇进入墨镜上方眉弓的极近特写。一滴汗珠凝结、拉长、脱落。心跳声加剧。

08–09：
跟随这滴汗珠下移至抛光地面。它撞击地面时发出一声异常清晰、近距离收音的「TIK」。心跳声立即中断。

09–10：
快速甩镜（whip-pan）至原始哨兵的耳朵。两只耳朵精准地转向刀锋警长。摄影机绕行逼近它刚警觉起来的眼睛。

10–11：
延续绕行弧线，哨兵缓缓转向他。它警觉的表情变成嘲弄的咧嘴笑，露出不齐的獠牙。

11–12：
沿货架缝隙横移，五只增援从低矮金条堆后的蹲姿中起身。头、帽子与巨耳以阴森的协同方式依次显现。

12–13：
升镜至清晰的俯视图：恰好六只小恶魔在唯一的主角周围围成一圈，基座就在他伸手可及之处。确立每一位攻击者的位置。

13–14：
降至小恶魔高度，沿圆环横扫，六只同时龇出獠牙并一同咆哮（ROAR）。主角站在中央，体型完全压制它们。

14–15：
迅速拉为低位广角，六只同时屈膝、伸出利爪，从既定位置一同朝主角扑来。

15–16：
进入短暂慢动作。围绕主角环绕半圈，六名攻击者穿过同一物理空间逼近，利爪在前，耳朵张开，尾巴拖曳。

16–17：
紧贴其右侧跟拍，他将风衣向后甩出并拔出左轮手枪。腾空的小恶魔在移动的风衣之后仍然可见；拔枪动作清晰且连贯。

17–18：
沿他的手臂急速上摇，他将左轮手枪直指正上方（STRAIGHT UP）的加固天花板。攻击者逼近。开枪前有一瞬近乎静默。

18–19：
他朝上射出恰好一发子弹（EXACTLY ONE SHOT）。呈现一次枪口火焰与一次后坐力，以及天花板远处的小小弹着点。快速切至广角，一道透明具有折射感的压力前沿自枪口扩散穿过金色大厅，扭曲反光并扬起细微尘埃。伴随枪声回到实时速度。

19–20：
推近原始哨兵，声音抵达它时。它巨大的耳朵向后折叠并颤动；它 smug 的表情瞬间转为惊愕恐慌。它双手抓住双耳尖叫。

20–21：
横移跟拍其他腾空中的攻击者，它们同样捂住耳朵、失去协调。它们的利爪不再伸向主角。同一声枪响在整个金库中回荡。

21–22：
低位横向跟拍前三只小恶魔翻滚并滑落到地面。金条在货架上哗啦作响；少数几根移动并发出叮当声，但不引发货架倒塌。

22–23：
延续运动拉至更广的视角，剩下三只依次错落落地并倒下。六只现已全部倒地，仍活着且发懵，紧抓着耳朵。主角保持站立。

23–24：
向主角推近，他平静地放下左轮手枪并放回同一右侧枪套。原始哨兵仍戴着它的警帽。

24–25：
跟拍他的左手，干净利落地从基座上提起带把的合拢公文箱。最后沉重的余响淡为细小的金属晃动声。

25–26：
在他身前向后移动（dolly backward），他提着公文箱、左手提箱，走向已经打开的金库门。每一步都沉稳有力，风衣随之摆动。

26–27：
转到低位侧角。沿着他的路径，原始哨兵仍倒在地上，虚弱地撑起上半身，帽子歪斜。主角微微屈腰屈膝，将空出的右手置于自然可及的距离。

27–28：
紧凑跟拍特写：右手食指随意地（ONE）轻弹一下帽檐。帽子被弹飞并旋转离开。他立即站直继续前行。

28–29：
跟随旋转的帽子下移至地面。它落地，金属徽章发出一声细小的「CLINK」，帽子停在被制服的哨兵身旁。

29–30：
滑入哨兵裸露耳朵的最终特写，那只耳朵因这声细响而反射性地抽动。变焦拉焦至背景中提着公文箱走出敞开的金库门的刀锋警长（BLADE SHERIFF）。以他不紧不慢的离去与哨兵受辱的反应收尾。

声音

无 BGM、无节奏音乐、无音乐音效点缀、无对白、无旁白。

仅使用环境声与动作音效：
微弱通风声、克制的皮革摩擦声、逐渐增强的主观心跳、单次夸张的汗滴撞击声、利爪刮擦金属、六次生物咆哮、风衣甩动声、拔枪声、一声（ONE）低沉震荡的枪声、同一发枪声（SAME shot）的层叠回响、非语言的生物尖叫、身体坠落声、金条哗啦声、公文箱提手声、有节制的靴步声，以及最后帽子徽章的轻响。

心跳是主观紧张效果，并非哨兵能听到的声音。汗滴撞击声是侦测触发点。让枪声通过对比与回响显得有力量，且不失真、不削波。

约束

保持指定的动作顺序与耳朵弱点的收尾兑现。慢动作仅限于合围扑击与拔枪；其余部分保持有目的、持续运动。

那一发子弹向上射入天花板。六只小恶魔是被这一虚构的音波效果压制，而非被子弹击中。

不要出现血液、伤口、肢解、死亡、额外射击、激光、魔法光束、发光环、闪电、火球、房间坍塌或额外的战斗动作。

不要出现多余人员或小恶魔、尺度变化、服装互换、身体融合、重复主角、漂浮武器、瞬移道具或更换公文箱。

在最后一次弹指之前，原始哨兵必须一直戴着帽子。

不要动画、插画、漫画渲染、字幕、说明文字、标题卡、附加标志或角色设定图文字。保留参考图中可见的服装徽章。

@[ref1]: the Warrior. Take identity and costume only: spiked black hair with a white streak, scarred dark face, tattered spotted grey-white sleeveless long coat, large black prayer beads, bandage-wrapped arms with glowing circuit lines and shoulder seals, dark baggy trousers, wrapped sandals. One figure; the sheet layout and backdrop are not part of the film.
@[ref2]: the Golem. Towering black stone body with red-magenta lava cracks, glowing eyes and jagged glowing mouth, spiked shoulders.
@[ref3]: Tokoyami, the rune greatsword. Human-sized weapon: dark stone blade exactly as tall as the Warrior, reaching only ankle height on the Golem. Violet-magenta glowing runes, cyan edge glow, ring-shaped eye at the guard, long dark wrapped handle above the guard.

Summary: In a vast burning citadel plaza at night, the Warrior charges the tower-sized Golem, roars the rune greatsword Tokoyami down from a blackened sky, tears it from the ground at full sprint, transforms mid-run from pink-gold to violet and cyan, then cuts the Golem apart and destroys it, in premium dark fantasy 2D anime shot like an action-game boss cinematic.

Visual style: Premium hand-drawn 2D anime, sakuga-grade action animation, hard two-tone cel shading with a thin rim light and heavy black shadows. Scene 1 sits in a deep red firelight wash with the Golem's red-magenta glow; from the sword's landing a violet wash takes over, with cyan reserved for blade edges and eyes. Hand-drawn fire, lightning and shockwave effects, two-tone graphic smoke, stone that breaks into tumbling blocks with visible faces and weight, embers drifting at several depths, shading dropping to line only on the fastest frames. Ground-level wide lenses with tiny figures against huge ruins, and tight eye and hand close-ups.

Energy: The camera behaves like an action-game boss camera: tilting up bodies too large for the frame, riding close behind the runner, the lens snapping wider on every acceleration, the frame jolting with every impact. The environment rushes and rotates with the camera in drawn perspective. Every impact throws blocks, dust and embers; fires bend with each shockwave. Blades stretch into smears on every swing, and every cut visibly removes stone from the Golem. Real-time speed throughout.

Important: No subtitles. No music. No bgm. No score.

Sound: Sound effects and voice only: collapsing towers, deep Golem roars, roaring fire, wind, pounding footsteps, a rising energy whine before the sword lands and one enormous blast when it does. The Warrior has a young male voice and shouts in Japanese.

Scene 1: Continuous, vast citadel plaza at night. A paved plaza as wide as a battlefield under a full moon, ringed by tall stone towers, colonnades and a high arched aqueduct, many already broken and burning, the whole scene washed in red firelight. Exactly two characters. The Golem, as tall as the towers, rampages at screen left. The Warrior, unarmed, arm circuits glowing pink-gold and eyes pink, runs in from screen right.
Shot 1 (0-2s): Extreme wide shot from ground level, tilt up. The tiny Warrior sprints away from camera across the foreground paving; the camera tilts up the Golem's body, too large for the frame, as it rips a burning tower in half and the top crashes down in tumbling blocks and embers. Ends on the Golem's glowing face.
Shot 2 (2-3s): Medium shot of the Golem, low angle, the lens snapping wider. The Golem spots the Warrior, roars, and hurls a house-sized chunk of tower straight toward the camera; the chunk swells until it fills the frame. Ends with the chunk blotting out the sky.
Shot 3 (3-4s): Wide shot, the camera riding close behind the sprinting Warrior, plaza rushing past with full parallax. The tower chunk smashes into the paving just ahead and bursts into tumbling blocks; the Warrior drops into a slide beneath a spinning block that skims the lens. Ends with him back on his feet at full sprint.
Shot 4 (4-7s): Close-up of the Warrior's face from the front, camera pulling back ahead of him as he runs, embers streaking past. Warrior's line (roared at full voice, the name drawn out): {お前を呼ぶ…常闇！} On the name his eyes flash violet and every fire behind him dims at once. Ends with his mouth open in the roar.
Shot 5 (7-9s): Extreme wide shot from ground level, low angle, tilt up past the Golem's head. The clouds spiral open into a black ring that swallows the moon; the red light drains from the plaza. The Golem turns its face upward. A small violet star ignites inside the ring and drops as a thin streak. Ends with the streak about to land.
Shot 6 (9-11s): Wide shot, high angle, the camera diving with the thin violet streak. Tokoyami, a man-sized sword, stabs blade-first into the paving beside the Golem's foot, no taller than its ankle, a few strides ahead of the running Warrior: one inverted-color frame, then a flat violet shockwave ring races outward, paving bursting into blocks, the Golem skidding backward. Ends with the sword planted.

The tiny Warrior sprints away from camera across the foreground paving; the camera tilts up the Golem's body, too large for the frame, as it rips a burning tower in half and the top crashes down in tumbling blocks and embers. Ends on the Golem's glowing face.
Shot 2 (2-3s): Medium shot of the Golem, low angle, the lens snapping wider. The Golem spots the Warrior, roars, and hurls a house-sized chunk of tower straight toward the camera; the chunk swells until it fills the frame. Ends with the chunk blotting out the sky.
Shot 3 (3-4s): Wide shot, the camera riding close behind the sprinting Warrior, plaza rushing past with full parallax. The tower chunk smashes into the paving just ahead and bursts into tumbling blocks; the Warrior drops into a slide beneath a spinning block that skims the lens. Ends with him back on his feet at full sprint.
Shot 4 (4-7s): Close-up of the Warrior's face from the front, camera pulling back ahead of him as he runs, embers streaking past. Warrior's line (roared at full voice, the name drawn out): {お前を呼ぶ…常闇！} On the name his eyes flash violet and every fire behind him dims at once. Ends with his mouth open in the roar.
Shot 5 (7-9s): Extreme wide shot from ground level, low angle, tilt up past the Golem's head. The clouds spiral open into a black ring that swallows the moon; the red light drains from the plaza. The Golem turns its face upward. A small violet star ignites inside the ring and drops as a thin streak. Ends with the streak about to land.
Shot 6 (9-11s): Wide shot, high angle, the camera diving with the thin violet streak. Tokoyami, a man-sized sword, stabs blade-first into the paving beside the Golem's foot, no taller than its ankle, a few strides ahead of the running Warrior: one inverted-color frame, then a flat violet shockwave ring races outward, paving bursting into blocks, the Golem skidding backward. Ends with the sword planted.
Shot 7 (11-12s): Close-up of Tokoyami's handle and ring-eye guard, fast push in. The Warrior's right hand flies in from screen right and clamps around the dark wrapped handle above the guard, fingers fully closed on the grip. A single white flash frame; the ring eye ignites. Ends with the fist locked on the handle.
Shot 8 (12-13s): Wide shot from ground level, side view, whip track left. The Warrior, right fist on Tokoyami's handle, never slows: he tears the blade out of the paving mid-stride, the blade stretching into a violet smear, a trench of violet fire ripping open behind him. Ends with the sword free and trailing flame.

Scene 2: Continuous, the same plaza, mid-charge, now washed in violet light under the black sky. The Warrior sprints toward screen left with Tokoyami in his right hand by the handle, blade trailing fire behind him. The Golem recovers ahead at screen left among the ruins. During this run the Warrior's awakened state takes over: circuits, shoulder seals and eyes violet-magenta with cyan edges.
Shot 9 (13-15s): Medium close-up of the sprinting Warrior, the camera running alongside and swinging around toward his front, fully animated fluid motion. Violet flame roars from Tokoyami's handle up his right arm; the pink-gold circuits shatter off like glass sparks and reform violet-magenta with cyan edges, band by band, across both shoulder seals. Ends with both arms blazing violet.
Shot 10 (15-16s): Close-up of the Warrior's face from the front, camera pulling back ahead of him, a quick push in at the end. Still running, his figure flattens to a black silhouette with glowing violet seams, then his eyes open violet with a thin cyan ring, the white hair streak lit cyan. A violet burst ring expands from him. Ends on the violet stare.
Shot 11 (16-17s): Wide shot, the camera riding low behind the Warrior, the lens snapping wider. The violet-lit Warrior accelerates into a streak, each footfall cratering the paving, Tokoyami carving a ribbon of violet light; ahead the Golem fills the black sky and swings both fists down toward him. Ends with the fists about to land.
Shot 12 (17-18s): Extreme wide shot from ground level, side view, track left with a tilt up, the frame jolting. The Golem's fists hit and the plaza erupts in a wave of tumbling blocks; the Warrior at screen right springs off a flying slab above the wave and rises toward the Golem's chest at screen left, Tokoyami drawn back in his right hand. Ends with him airborne.

Scene 3: Continuous, the same plaza, violet wash under the black sky. The Warrior, circuits and eyes violet-magenta with cyan edges, is airborne with Tokoyami in his right hand, rising toward the Golem at screen left. From here every cut on the Golem stays: its stone parts break away in tumbling blocks and each wound glows violet.
Shot 13 (18-20s): Medium shot, low angle, the frame jolting. The Golem's right fist swings at the airborne Warrior; Tokoyami sweeps through the forearm in one violet arc with a white flash frame. The Warrior sprints up the Golem's planted left arm toward its shoulder, Tokoyami dragging through the stone beside him and carving a long violet-glowing trench; armor blocks peel off behind him. Ends with him at the shoulder.

He launches off the Golem's shoulder high above its head and takes Tokoyami's handle in both hands; the runes surge from violet to blazing cyan. The sound drops to wind alone. Ends with the blade raised overhead.
Shot 17 (24-25s): Low angle, fast push in. Far below, the one-armed Golem roars up at him, its blazing red-magenta mouth and eyes filling the frame. Ends on the open maw.

Ends with the Warrior crouched at the Golem's feet.

The Golem is split in two from crown to feet along a blazing violet seam; its red-magenta light flickers out, the eyes go dark, and the two halves slide apart and collapse into mountains of tumbling black blocks. The Warrior stays crouched in the foreground. Ends with the last blocks falling.

Prompt: Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home-video showing an ordinary summer afternoon in the life of a young Korean woman. No reference image.
MAIN SUBJECT
Young Korean woman in her early 20s, naturally pretty, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, relaxed and confident personality.
Long black hair loosely tied into a messy side ponytail with a few loose strands around her face. Wearing a fitted pastel-blue short top, loose cream pajama-style pants, black sneakers and a simple silver necklace.
Maintain the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions and overall appearance throughout the entire video.
SETTING
A quiet older Seoul residential neighborhood during a warm summer afternoon. Narrow concrete lanes, small houses, old walls, potted plants, parked bicycles, utility poles, overhead wires, laundry hanging outside homes, a tiny convenience store and children playing football in the street.
Everything should feel lived-in, ordinary and peaceful. No tourist attractions, advertisements, recognizable brands or commercial activity.
CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC
Raw personal footage casually recorded by a friend on an early-2000s consumer DV camcorder.
Strong handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, occasional motion blur, faded colors, soft digital detail, mild noise, accidental zooms and natural camera imperfections.
No stabilization, drone footage, gimbal movement, dramatic lighting or polished commercial cinematography.
— OUTSIDE THE HOUSE
She steps outside carrying a small reusable shopping bag.
She locks the door, adjusts her messy ponytail and gives the camera a relaxed smile.
She starts walking down the narrow neighborhood lane.
A light summer breeze moves her hair naturally.
— MEETING THE SCHOOL CHILDREN
A few school children wearing backpacks come walking toward her from the opposite direction.
She recognizes them from the neighborhood.
She smiles, raises her hand and says:
“Hey, aren't you guys late?”
The children laugh and continue walking toward school.
One child briefly waves back at her.
She laughs and continues down the street.
— CHILDREN PLAYING FOOTBALL
A little farther down the lane, several neighborhood children are playing football in the street.
The ball rolls toward her and stops directly in front of her feet.
She looks down at the ball.
Then looks toward the children.
One child calls out:
“Noona! Kick it!”
She smiles.
She gently places one foot beside the ball.
She gives the football one playful kick back toward the children.
The ball rolls smoothly along the concrete toward them.
The children excitedly chase after it.
She laughs and continues walking.
The football remains with the children after she kicks it. It does not disappear, duplicate or suddenly return to her.
— QUIET WALK HOME
She continues walking toward the end of the lane.
She passes a small public water tap and stops briefly to rinse her hands.
She shakes the water from her fingers, fixes a loose strand of hair and looks toward the camera.
A bicycle passes behind her.
She smiles and starts walking again.
— FINAL MOMENT
She reaches the corner of the neighborhood.
The children are now playing football farther behind her.
She turns around and watches them for a moment.
One of the children notices the camera and waves.
She waves back.
She turns toward the camera with a small playful smile and says:
“See you tomorrow.”
She continues walking home.
The camera follows behind her as she disappears around the corner.
The recording abruptly cuts to black.
AUDIO
Natural location sound only: children shouting and laughing, football bouncing against concrete, footsteps, birds, summer insects, bicycle bells, distant scooters, neighborhood conversations, leaves moving in the breeze and subtle camera-handling noise.
No music. No narration. Only the two spoken lines specified above.

Prompt structure (style paragraph + named phases) inspired by @aimikoda's openly shared Seedance 2.5 prompt.

HOW TO USE
Step 1. Attach the character sheet as Image 1 (use CLIP-Character-Sheet-v1-1600.jpg; big files can fail to upload).
Step 2. Paste ONE act below as the prompt. Model: Seedance 2.5, 16:9, 15 seconds.
Step 3. Draft at 480p first. Only upscale the take you like.
Step 4. For Acts 2-4, also attach the last frame of the previous act as the start frame, so the world stays the same.
Step 5. Add music and sound in your editor. The prompts ask for no music on purpose.

The film is 4 acts = 4 generations. Every act repeats the same style paragraph, so each one works on its own.

ACT 1 — INFILTRATION
==================================================================

Theatrical 2D Japanese anime caper staged like a classic spy-thriller heist: bold hand-inked outlines, flat cel shading with crisp two-tone shadows, painted night backgrounds and subtle paper grain, never 3D, never CGI, never photoreal. Wide horizontal 16:9 cinematic film. The hero is CLIP, a tiny spy no bigger than a paperclip: his head is a bent flat lavender wire loop holding two big white eyes and heavy black eyebrows, no mouth; charcoal double-breasted trench coat, charcoal fedora with a grey band, thin black arms and legs, black shoes. Image 1 is his character sheet: copy his design exactly in every shot and never show the sheet's panels, labels or text. Scale drives the comedy: a two-inch hero against towering steel doors, giant server racks and giant boots, shot with low floor-level lenses, extreme close-ups on his eyebrows, slow suspense push-ins and sudden snap cuts. Tension lives in stillness and timing: frozen holds, a single sweat drop, a held breath, then one quick burst of motion with expressive smear frames. Night from the first frame to the last: deep navy shadows, electric server green, emergency red only where stated. Clean silhouettes, readable action and one clear cause and effect per shot. Exactly one cartoon character, two arms, two legs, eyes never glowing, the wire never glows. No on-screen text, letters, signs or logos. Nobody speaks, only small sound effects, no music.

Ground-level tracking shot at the bottom of a giant steel security door with a thin line of light under it. CLIP tiptoes in, turns sideways edge-on, flat as a wire, and slides through the gap until he is gone, a tiny puff of dust behind him. Soft metallic scrape.

Tracking behind him inside a dusty metal ceiling vent. CLIP crawls on his stomach past dust bunnies and cobwebs to a square grate and peeks down through the slats, eyes wide. Low hum of air.

WHY IT WORKS (the structure)
1. One style paragraph sets the whole world first: medium, hero design, camera language, timing, palette, rules.
2. Then short named phases, one clear action each, in order. Seedance cuts between them on its own.
3. Rules live inside the style paragraph (one character, no glowing eyes, no text), so every act keeps them.
4. No quoted dialogue, no durations and no music in the prompt. Those cause failed or messy takes.

使用方法
第 1 步。将角色设定表作为 Image 1 附上（使用 CLIP-Character-Sheet-v1-1600.jpg；文件过大会导致上传失败）。
第 2 步。将下方任意一幕（ONE act）粘贴为提示词。模型：Seedance 2.5, 16:9, 15 秒。
第 3 步。先以 480p 试拍。只对你喜欢的那个 take 进行放大。
第 4 步。对于第 2-4 幕，还要附上上一幕的最后一帧作为起始帧，以保持世界的一致。
第 5 步。在你的剪辑器中添加音乐和音效。提示词刻意要求不要音乐。

全片共 4 幕 = 4 次生成。每一幕都重复同一段风格段落，因此每一幕都可以独立使用。

为什么有效（结构说明）
1. 先用一段风格段落确立整个世界：媒介形式、主角设计、镜头语言、节奏、色彩、规则。
2. 然后是简短的命名阶段，每个阶段一个清晰动作，依次排列。Seedance 会在它们之间自行剪辑切换。
3. 规则写在风格段落里（一个角色、眼睛不发光、不出现文字），因此每一幕都保留这些规则。
4. 提示词中不含引号内的对白、不含时长、也不含音乐。这些会导致拍摄失败或画面混乱。

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Complete revised sequence: 30 seconds, 16:9, photoreal live-action epic fantasy cinema.
Restore monumental scale, violent impacts, the furious eye close-up, the rotating thrown sword and the backlit victory.

SETTING AND REFERENCES
Daylight in an enormous ancient Roman-inspired fortress. Towering stone curtain walls with a jagged silhouette of deep crenellations enclose a vast sandy courtyard. The high parapets stand far above the Minotaur. Maintain this immense scale throughout, including the hero's leap from the actual TOP of the high wall. Heavy timber gates, weathered blocks, harsh sunlight and airborne grit. Keep the sun fixed in the world; position the final camera so the sun is behind the hero.

@Image 1 = the ONLY hero, approximately 190 cm tall: short dark hair, beard, cheek scars, muscular body, golden armor, ragged pale cloak, boots and the exact reference sword. He remains bareheaded.
@Image 2 = allied bronze infantry: turquoise patina, crested helmets, round shields and worn cloaks. The defenders also carry ordinary handheld spears. All remain helmeted.
@Image 3 = the ONE approximately 4.2 m Minotaur War King: original bull head, head armor, broad forward-curving horns, bone armor, black-and-white body markings, massive axe, furred shins and cloven hooves. The red circular target stays on his anatomical LEFT upper shoulder.
@Image 4 = enemy infantry: dark iron helmets, chainmail, fur cloaks, dark armor, curved swords and round wooden shields. All remain helmeted.
Preserve identities, proportions, materials and equipment. Reference sheets supply appearance only; their text, borders and layout never appear.

WEAPON CONTINUITY — ONE PHYSICAL SWORD
Before the throw, the hero holds his single sword in his RIGHT hand, including through the wall impact.
During 21–22 seconds, show an actual release: his fingers open, the sword leaves, and his hand becomes EMPTY.
During 22–23 seconds, there is exactly one airborne sword, making a controlled end-over-end rotation in slow motion.
During 23–24 seconds, its POINT enters the center of the red shoulder target first. Most of the blade sinks deeply into the shoulder; the guard, hilt and a short section of blade remain outside. The point is buried, never pointing outward from the body.
From impact until the visible extraction during 27–28 seconds, the sword stays rigidly embedded in the SAME shoulder at the SAME depth and angle relative to that shoulder. It moves with the shoulder as the Minotaur staggers and falls backward. The hero remains empty-handed.
The embedded hilt stays clearly visible in the wider views, during the fall, on the supine body and while the hero climbs onto him. Dust, framing and the hero's body must not conceal it.
During 27–28 seconds, show the hero's right hand grasp that exact hilt and pull that exact blade completely free along its entry axis in one continuous action. Only then does he have a sword again.
The extracted sword is the same object raised in the final pose. Never show both an embedded sword and a second sword in his hand.

OTHER PHYSICAL CONTINUITY
Opening spear attacks strike hard chest armor and the outer shoulder rings, never the red center. Shafts snap outside the body and debris falls away. No arrows, bows or lingering spear fragments in the target.
Each furred shin ends above a solid dark hoof with exactly two distinct halves and a clear central cleft. Keep the hard hoof walls and edges visible below the fur.
Preserve a connected head, neck, torso, pelvis and four limbs. Both large horns remain rooted in the skull with the original shape and forward curvature; they rotate only with the head.
The Minotaur falls BACKWARD and finishes SUPINE, chest and muzzle facing upward. Show that transition, rather than cutting from one body orientation to another. His axe lands flat on his right side, clear of his head and the hero's path.

CAMERA AND RHYTHM
Action-movie camerawork continues every second throughout the entire video.
One-second beats describe evolving action, not mandatory hard cuts. Use forceful tracking, low angles, whip-pans, plunging camera movement and brief impact shake, while keeping contact readable.
The kick, flight and wall collision form a continuous side-tracking action.
Use slow motion specifically for the spinning sword; return to real time at penetration.
From the shoulder impact through extraction, use a connected three-quarter camera move from the marked LEFT-shoulder side; widen for the fall and keep the embedded sword visible.
Finish from a very low angle, then slowly crane upward while arcing around the hero, with the sun behind him. Do not replace this with a static wide shot.

SECOND-BY-SECOND SEQUENCE

00–01s:
Inside the monumental fortress, bronze defenders brace overlapping shields against the buckling timber gate. Push low along skidding boots and shaking shields; towering crenellated walls rise behind them.

01–02s:
The gate explodes inward under the Minotaur's impact. Huge splinters, beams and shields fly toward the retreating camera. Soldiers are knocked backward through dust. Physical destruction, not a fireball.

02–03s:
The Minotaur storms through the breach with his axe raised. Track from a crushing hoof strike up to his horned bull head. Human soldiers establish his size; the much higher walls establish the fortress's scale.

03–04s:
Allies thrust their spears against his chest armor and outer shoulder rings. Shafts buckle and snap as the soldiers recoil. Track laterally through the failed impacts; no weapon stays embedded.

04–05s:
Push into the original red shoulder circle, pristine at its center. Broken spear pieces fall past it without entering it. Pull with the shoulder as the Minotaur winds up his axe.

05–06s:
One enormous axe sweep smashes the overlapping shield line. Shields buckle and several allies are hurled sideways together. Follow the axe through visible contact, then whip-pan with the flying soldiers and debris.

06–07s:
Two sharp reaction inserts: a helmeted ally recoils and runs in terror; another crashes into the sand beneath his shield and struggles to rise. Preserve the frantic momentum.

07–08s:
Dark enemy infantry flood through the ruined gate behind the Minotaur. Sweep across the advancing ranks, then whip-tilt up the full towering wall to reveal the golden hero on its highest crenellated parapet.

08–09s:
The hero launches from the TOP of the high wall into the vast drop. A plunging camera follows beside him, showing many courses of stone racing upward behind his falling body. His ragged cloak lashes violently.

09–10s:
Continue the rapid descent into a thunderous courtyard landing. Sand and loose grit erupt around his boots. Swing low toward his bare face and golden armor as he rises immediately into an attack.

10–11s:
He charges alone into the enemy wave, knocks aside the first shield and slashes across the armored attacker, dropping him. Track at waist height through the contact and follow-through.

11–12s:
He parries a second enemy's curved sword and drives a returning slash across armor. The attacker tumbles backward as the camera moves tightly beside the hero's forward advance.

12–13s:
A third enemy attacks from the flank. The hero pivots beneath the blade and slashes him into the next rank. A fast controlled arc reveals the surrounding attackers without losing the hero.

13–14s:
The hero checks a rear attacker with his left elbow and turns into a decisive right-hand sword strike. Whip-pan with the turn to reveal a cleared lane and the approaching Minotaur.

14–15s:
The Minotaur recognizes him and roars, raising the massive axe overhead. Push low past the hero's shoulder toward the towering beast, horns and axe silhouetted against the crenellated walls.

15–16s:
The axe crashes into the paving as the hero rolls aside. Stone splits and chunks blast across the courtyard. Track the roll at ground level, keeping the blade's impact visible.

16–17s:
The Minotaur drives a devastating kick into the hero's breastplate, launching him violently backward into the stone wall within this beat. Track continuously from contact to flight to back-first collision. Spiderweb cracks burst outward from the impact point; stone fragments and dense sand spray outward.

17–18s:
The hero immediately drops from the wall and collapses onto one knee amid falling debris. His chin stays tucked, back rounded and arms bent; no hovering or seated flight. He still grips the sword in his right hand and wipes blood from his mouth with his left as he forces himself up. The spreading wall cracks remain behind him.

18–19s:
EXTREME CLOSE-UP of his eyes and blood-streaked brow. A thin trail of blood runs along his temple and cheek. He stares directly into the camera with furious, narrowed eyes. Push closer with a tiny controlled camera move; hold the rage clearly instead of cutting away immediately.

19–20s:
His gaze shifts from the lens toward the Minotaur's red shoulder target. Follow the eyeline to its central disk as the giant begins charging. The hero sets his stance and draws his sword arm back.

20–21s:
A low three-quarter tracking shot follows the charging legs. Fur ends above clearly defined two-part hooves; each landing drives a sharp burst of dust outward. Lift the framing to establish the clear line between the hero and the left-shoulder target.

21–22s:
The hero forcefully throws his ONE sword overarm from his right hand toward the charging Minotaur. Show the release and the now-empty hand in the same shot. Follow the sword leaving him, with its target ahead.

22–23s:
SLOW-MOTION CLOSE-UP tracking beside the spinning sword. It makes one controlled end-over-end rotation through sunlit dust, revealing the same blade, guard and hilt from the reference. The Minotaur and red circle remain readable ahead. Its point leads as it reaches the target.

23–24s:
Return to real time as the point drives DEEPLY into the exact center of the red shoulder target. The blade stops rotating and locks into the shoulder; the hilt protrudes outward. In the same moving shot, widen to show the Minotaur's violent recoil and sudden loss of strength. Keep the embedded sword unmistakably visible.

24–25s:
The Minotaur staggers backward, knees buckling under his weight, and drops his axe flat on his right side. Continue the three-quarter move without hiding the left shoulder. The embedded hilt moves with his shoulder at an unchanged angle and depth; the hero's hands remain empty.

25–26s:
He falls BACKWARD: hips descend, his broad back and shoulders slam into the courtyard, and his legs settle forward. A heavy ground impact throws dust outward. His chest and muzzle face upward; his head, neck and horns stay attached and anatomically coherent. The sword still protrudes visibly from the same left shoulder, with its hilt clear of the ground and facing the camera side.

26–27s:

优先保证对参考视频的忠实还原，而非创意性再诠释。以相同的 chronological 顺序再现原本的 15 秒故事，保留原有的角色、动作、构图、镜头视角、转场、环境与情绪递进。不要创作新的场景，也不要改变结尾。

Seedance 2.5 提示词
基本方向
30 秒影片，16:9。

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
BASIC DIRECTION
30-second film, 16:9. Photoreal live-action Hollywood creature-action cinema. One continuous location: a broad red-sandstone canyon basin at dawn, with rocky ledges and a low saddle beyond the far ridge. Warm sunrise, cool shadows, airborne sand, realistic skin, feathers, bone, stone and volcanic heat distortion. Fast, heavy action followed by a terrifying reversal. Begin with the juvenile already charging; no opening titles or setup shot.

REFERENCE LOCK
@Image 1 = the tribal chief, approximately 4m tall. Preserve his exact face, muscular proportions, black hair, feather headdress, red-and-white body paint, skull shoulder armor, garments, bone footwear and distinctive bone blade.
@Image 2 = juvenile Gaia Rhinos, 12m TOTAL BODY LENGTH, approximately 5.5m shoulder height. Preserve its pale stone armor, black dorsal spikes, horns, red molten fissures, circular shoulder markings, four legs and armored tail.
@Image 3 = parent Gaia Rhinos, 50m TOTAL BODY LENGTH, approximately 14m shoulder height and 18m overall height including its horn. Preserve this reference's darker armor, enormous pale horn, spikes, glowing red fissures, shoulder spirals and quadrupedal silhouette. Use this image as the parent regardless of the printed sheet name.
Supporting cast: adult Native American warriors in this fictional fantasy setting, normal human height, visually distinct individuals with ropes, spears and shields. Only the chief has @Image 1's giant proportions and exact regalia.
The two beasts are separate individuals. The parent is not a transformation or enlarged duplicate of the juvenile. Maintain their different designs and fixed dimensions. Preserve the large circular red markings on their shoulders; do not move these markings onto their faces. For the reveal, the parent's actual small eyes glow with subtle red concentric light inside the irises, without changing their shape or position. Reference sheets provide appearance only, never layouts, labels or backgrounds.

CAMERA AND CONTINUITY
Action-movie camerawork continues every second throughout the entire video.
Each one-second interval is a moving-camera beat, not a compulsory edit. Join compatible beats into continuous shots. Keep action direction, cliff positions and eyelines coherent. Show contact, force and consequences clearly. Use foreground rocks, normal-size warriors and the 4m chief as scale references. Motion blur stays directional; silhouettes remain readable. Only the blade impact uses brief slow motion. During the final reveal, deliberate rising and widening camera moves reveal scale without frantic cutting.

TIMELINE
00–01s: Ground-level camera retreats from the charging juvenile. Its forefoot slams beside the lens, kicking stones past camera as the canyon floor shakes. Immediate weight and danger.

01–02s: Fast lateral tracking reveals the juvenile's entire 12m body racing through the red canyon, with small warriors concealed along the ledges for scale.

02–03s: Crane rapidly up to a low angle on the 4m chief. He raises his bone blade in a sharp signal while watching the beast below.

03–04s: Whip-pan along the ridge as the hidden warriors rise together and cast thick lassos. Loops fly toward the juvenile from both sides.

04–05s: Moving high angle follows loops catching around horn bases and armored shoulders. Lines anchored around rock outcrops tighten as other warriors release prepared boulders.

05–06s: Low lateral tracking catches boulders smashing against the juvenile's stone armor. Rock fragments and hot mineral sparks burst outward; its charge staggers but continues.

06–07s: Track beside the juvenile as it twists and drags the taut ropes. Anchors break loose, loose lines whip behind it, and warriors holding the lines skid across sand.

07–08s: A close three-quarter tracking shot shows the juvenile sweeping its horn sideways. The blunt side strikes one warrior's raised shield and launches him off his feet, without piercing him.

08–09s: Whip-pan follows the airborne warrior into a tumbling landing on a sandy slope. His shield rolls ahead; he moves after landing. No graphic injury.

09–10s: Whip back to the juvenile bucking broadside beneath the chief's ledge. A molten seam between dorsal armor plates flares into view as its back twists.

10–11s: Low forward dolly follows the chief sprinting one step and launching from the ledge, bone blade ready. The juvenile remains visibly below him.

11–12s: Descending side tracking follows his short, heavy drop toward the juvenile's back. Feathers stream upward; his feet target the gap between dorsal spikes.

12–13s: Close moving profile shows his feet land on the armored back. He absorbs the impact with bent knees and braces against the beast's violent bucking.

13–14s: Brief half-second slow motion: the chief drives the bone blade into the existing molten ARMOR SEAM. A tight lateral arc clearly shows blade contact, cracking stone and red mineral sparks. No flesh or blood.

14–15s: Snap back to real time. The juvenile's forelegs buckle. The chief pulls his blade free and springs toward the adjacent low rock ledge as the body tilts.

15–16s: Wide lateral tracking follows the juvenile sliding forward, scraping the canyon floor. Its collapsing mass plows a deep furrow through sand and loose stone.

16–17s: Rising wide shot: the juvenile falls onto its side with a colossal impact. A rolling sand cloud spreads outward; the chief is visible safely on the nearby rock.

17–18s: Sweep past the warriors as they raise their spears and give a brief, wordless victory cheer. Keep the fallen juvenile visible beyond them.

18–19s: Low dolly toward the juvenile's face. Its actual eye flickers weakly and it releases a low, sustained, wavering distress call; the celebration continues farther away.

19–20s: Tight moving eye detail. The call weakens and trails away; the eye fades out. The juvenile dies and becomes completely still.

20–21s: Telephoto push toward the empty distant canyon. A much deeper roar answers with the same wavering quality. The parent remains entirely hidden.

21–22s: Macro camera slides across the dead juvenile's armor. Tiny pebbles jump in rhythmic tremors, then larger grains begin bouncing. The body itself stays motionless.

22–23s: Dolly along the warriors' faces. Their cheers stop abruptly; raised spears waver and one lowers. Every gaze turns toward the far ridge.

23–24s: Low forward push from behind the chief. He looks toward the approaching tremors as dust trickles off the ridge and the ground vibrates more strongly.

24–25s: Crane upward toward the ridge. The parent's enormous pale horn pierces the moving dust first, followed by the upper edge of its dark armored head.

25–26s: Continue tilting upward. Its real eyes glow red high above the warriors, with subtle concentric iris light. Its separate glowing shoulder spirals emerge lower and farther back.

26–27s: Pull back and rise into a wide three-quarter view as the entire 50m parent advances through the low saddle into the basin. All four legs and its long armored body become readable.

27–28s: Continue into a wide lateral composition showing the dead 12m juvenile, the 4m chief, normal-size warriors and the 50m parent together at comparable depth. The parent stops beside its offspring and lowers its muzzle toward the still body.

28–29s: Arc behind the chief's shoulder. Beyond him, the parent lifts its head from the dead juvenile and fixes its gaze on the warriors. Hold the size contrast and the sudden understanding.

29–30s: Tight low-angle push on the chief's face and hands. Silent, jaw set, he regrips the SAME bone blade and raises his guard toward the parent. Hard cut to black at 29.8s; end at 30.0s.

SOUND
Diegetic effects only: canyon wind, thunderous footfalls, rope strain and snaps, rushing air, impacts, scraping stone, volcanic crackle, sand, armor movement, breathing, brief wordless cheers and creature calls.
The juvenile's fading call and the parent's answering roar must sound related, with the parent's voice vastly deeper and heavier. After the answer, human cheering stops; retain wind, breathing and approaching seismic footfalls. Let the parent's final exhale cut off with the blackout.
NO BGM, score, musical drone, percussion track, dialogue, narration or spoken words.

EXCLUSIONS
No anime, illustration, stylized game rendering, reference-sheet panels, captions, subtitles, logos, text or interface elements. No blood, gore, dismemberment or impalement of humans. Damage is stone armor, sparks and sand. No firearms, additional powers, fire breath, energy beams, extra beasts, duplicated chiefs, character fusion, changing sizes, revival of the juvenile or early visual reveal of the parent. The parent remains quadrupedal. No prolonged slow motion, static slideshow or dust hiding the decisive blade impact and final scale comparison.

Seedance 2.5 提示词
基本方向
30 秒影片，16:9。照片级真人实拍好莱坞怪兽动作电影。单一连贯地点：黎明的宽阔红砂岩峡谷盆地，岩层台阶与远侧山脊之外的一处低鞍部。温暖的日出、冷调阴影、飞扬的沙尘、真实的皮肤、羽毛、骨骼、石头与火山热浪扭曲。快速而沉重的动作，随后是令人恐惧的反转。开场即为幼兽正在冲锋；不要片头字幕或铺垫镜头。

参考锁定
@Image 1 = 部落首领，身高约 4m。保留他精确的面容、肌肉比例、黑发、羽毛头饰、红白身体彩绘、骷髅肩甲、服饰、骨制鞋履以及标志性的骨质刀刃。
@Image 2 = 幼年盖亚犀，12m 总体身长，肩高约 5.5m。保留其浅色石质装甲、黑色背脊尖刺、角、红热熔裂缝、圆形肩部纹样、四条腿与装甲尾巴。
@Image 3 = 成年盖亚犀，50m 总体身长，肩高约 14m，含角总高 18m。保留该参考图的更深色装甲、巨大的浅色角、尖刺、发光的红色裂缝、肩部螺旋纹与四足轮廓。无论打印的图纸名称为何，都使用此图作为成年体。
配角：本虚构奇幻设定中的成年美洲原住民战士，正常人类身高，各具清晰可辨的个体特征，配有绳索、长矛与盾牌。只有首领拥有 @Image 1 的巨人比例与精确仪装。
两头怪兽是彼此独立的个体。成年体不是幼兽的变形体或放大复制品。保持二者不同的设计与固定尺寸。保留它们肩部的大型红色圆形纹样；不要把这些纹样移到脸上。在揭示段落中，成年体真实的小眼睛在虹膜内部发出微弱的红色同心光，不得改变其形状或位置。参考图仅提供外观，绝不提供版式、标签或背景。

摄影机与连续性
全片每一秒都延续动作电影的摄影机调度。
每一秒区间都是一个运动摄影机节拍，而非强制剪辑点。将兼容的节拍连接为连续镜头。保持动作方向、悬崖位置与视线关系连贯。清晰展现接触、力量与后果。使用前景岩石、正常身高的战士以及 4m 首领作为尺度参照。运动模糊保持方向感；剪影始终清晰可辨。只有刀刃撞击使用短暂慢动作。在最终揭示段落中，以有意识的上升与拉宽运镜展现尺度感，避免慌乱剪辑。

时间轴
00–01s：地面高度的摄影机从冲锋的幼兽面前后撤。它的前掌在镜头旁重重踏下，将石块踢向镜头之外，峡谷地面随之震动。即刻的重量感与危险感。

01–02s：快速横向跟拍展现幼兽完整的 12m 身躯在红色峡谷中疾驰，小型战士隐蔽在台阶上以作尺度对比。

02–03s：快速升降镜头升到 4m 首领的低角度仰拍。他高举骨质刀刃作出利落的手势，同时注视下方的怪兽。

03–04s：沿山脊快速甩镜，隐藏的战士们同时起身投出粗重套索。绳圈从两侧飞向幼兽。

04–05s：移动的高角度镜头跟随绳圈缠上角根与装甲肩部。锚在岩石突出部上的绳索绷紧，同时其他战士放开预备好的巨石。

05–06s：低机位横向跟拍捕捉巨石砸在幼兽的石质装甲上。岩石碎屑与灼热矿物火花向外迸溅；它的冲锋踉跄但继续。

06–07s：贴着幼兽跟拍，看它扭转身体拖拽绷紧的绳索。锚点松脱，松开的绳索在身后抽打，拉着绳索的战士在沙地上滑行。

07–08s：近距离四分之三跟拍镜头展现幼兽横扫它的角。角的钝侧击中一名战士举起的盾牌，将他掀离双脚，但没有刺穿他。

08–09s：甩镜跟随空中的战士，翻滚着落在沙坡上。他的盾牌向前滚开；落地后他可以移动。无血腥伤害。

09–10s：甩回幼兽，它在首领所在的台阶下方横向剧烈跳动。背脊装甲板之间的一道熔融缝隙在其背部扭转时闪现。

10–11s：低机位前推跟拍首领助跑一步并从台阶上跃出，骨质刀刃在手。幼兽始终明显在他下方。

11–12s：下降的侧向跟拍跟随他短促而沉重地下落，朝幼兽背部落去。羽毛向上飘起；他的双脚瞄准背脊尖刺之间的缝隙。

12–13s：近距离移动侧面镜头展现他的双脚落在装甲背上。他屈膝吸收冲击，并抵挡住野兽剧烈的甩动。

13–14s：短暂半秒慢动作：首领将骨质刀刃刺入已有的熔融装甲缝隙。紧凑的横向弧线运动清晰展现刀刃接触、开裂的石头与红色矿物火花。没有血肉。

14–15s：瞬间回到实时。幼兽的前腿瘫软。首领拔出刀刃，趁身体倾斜之际跃向旁边的低矮岩石台阶。

15–16s：大幅横向跟拍展现幼兽向前滑行，刮擦峡谷地面。它坍塌的庞大身躯在沙与碎石中犁出一道深沟。

16–17s：上升的广角镜头：幼兽以巨大冲击侧倒在地翻滚。扩散的沙尘云铺开；首领可见安全地站在附近的岩石上。

17–18s：掠过战士们，他们举起长矛，发出短暂的无言胜利欢呼。保持坠落的幼兽在他们身后清晰可见。

18–19s：低机位推轨靠近幼兽的面部。它真实的眼睛微弱颤动，发出低沉、持续、颤抖的痛苦叫声；庆祝声在更远处继续。

19–20s：眼部紧凑移动特写。叫声减弱并渐渐消失；眼睛黯淡下去。幼兽死亡，彻底静止。

20–21s：长焦推近空旷的远处峡谷。一声深得多的咆哮以同样的颤抖质感回应。成年体始终完全隐藏。

21–22s：微距摄影机滑过死去幼兽的装甲。细小的石子随有节奏的震颤跳动，随后更大的颗粒开始弹跳。躯体本身保持不动。

22–23s：推轨掠过战士们的面孔。他们的欢呼戛然而止；举起的长矛晃动，其中一支放低。每一道目光都转向远侧山脊。

23–24s：从首领身后低机位前推。他望向逼近的震颤，尘土从山脊上簌簌落下，地面震动更为强烈。

24–25s：升降镜头升向山脊。成年体巨大的浅色角最先刺穿移动的尘雾，随后是它深色装甲头颅的上缘。

25–26s：继续向上倾斜。它真实的眼睛在战士们高处发出红光，虹膜中有微弱的同心光。它独立的发光肩部螺旋纹在更下方、更靠后处显现。

26–27s：拉远并升高至广角四分之三视角，整个 50m 的成年体穿过低鞍部进入盆地。全部四条腿与其修长的装甲身躯变得清晰可辨。

27–28s：继续转为广角横向构图，将死去的 12m 幼兽、4m 首领、正常身高的战士与 50m 成年体以相近景深一同呈现。成年体停在它的幼崽身旁，将口鼻朝静止的躯体低下。

28–29s：绕过首领肩部做弧线运动。在他身后，成年体从死去的幼兽身上抬起头，将目光锁定在战士们身上。保持尺寸对比与突然产生的了然神情。

29–30s：紧凑低角度推近首领的面部与双手。他沉默、下颌紧绷，重新握紧同一把骨质刀刃，抬起防御姿态朝向成年体。在 29.8s 处硬切黑场；于 30.0s 结束。

声音
仅有叙事内音效：峡谷风声、震撼的脚步声、绳索的绷紧与断裂、疾冲的气流、撞击、刮擦石面、火山噼啪声、沙土、装甲移动、呼吸、短暂的无言欢呼与兽吼。
幼兽渐弱的叫声与成年体的回应咆哮必须听来彼此相关，成年体的声音要深沉厚重得多。在回应之后，人类欢呼停止；保留风声、呼吸声与逐渐逼近的地震般的脚步声。让成年体最后的呼气随黑场戛然而止。
不要背景音乐、配乐、音乐低鸣、打击乐轨、对白、旁白或任何口语台词。

排除项
不要动漫、插画、风格化游戏渲染、参考图纸分栏、字幕、字幕条、标志、文字或界面元素。不要血腥、肢解或人类被穿刺。伤害表现为石质装甲、火花与沙土。不要枪械、额外能力、火焰吐息、能量光束、额外怪兽、复制的首领、角色融合、尺寸变化、幼兽复活或对成年体的提前视觉揭示。成年体保持四足。不要长时间慢动作、静态幻灯片，或用尘土遮挡决定性的刀刃撞击与最终的尺度对比。

Preserve the bright daytime colosseum look: sunlit sand, strong rim light through dust, monumental stone-and-metal architecture and packed spectator tiers. Keep faces readable in the backlight. Use convincing weight, hard impacts and weathered materials. One location, continuous time.
CHARACTERS AND REFERENCES

This image shows its UNDAMAGED starting appearance; later damage permanently overrides its original two-horn silhouette.

IRREVERSIBLE HORN STATE

At the impact during 19-20s: break ONLY the Beast's anatomical RIGHT horn at its root. In a straight frontal view, this is the horn on the viewer's left.
After that exact impact, through the end: ONE intact LEFT horn remains attached; the RIGHT side has ONLY a short, blunt, jagged stump with a dark mechanical fracture surface. Make the missing-horn gap unmistakable. Keep this damaged side visible in the later combat shots. Camera cuts, changes of angle and the original reference MUST NOT restore or mirror the missing horn.
There is exactly ONE detached right horn. It has the same curve, length, ivory ridges and black pointed tip it had while attached. It has ONE pointed black tip and ONE thick, blunt, irregular broken base. It is not a double-ended crescent, a pair of connected horns or a symmetrical U-shaped object.

The one-second intervals describe choreography, not mandatory cuts. Keep camera movement active in every interval while maintaining readable geography. Show actual contact, not just its aftermath. Use normal speed except for the single finishing slash at 22-23s.
Use a continuous shot across 18-21s to connect the attached horn, the impact, the damaged head and the falling fragment.
Use another continuous shot across 26-29s to connect the pickup, the throw, the horn's flight and its impact beside the Emperor. Then make ONE deliberate cut to his reaction at 29s.

12-13s：切到固定中景双人镜头，两人的面部均可见。无声的节拍，Mila 的笑容缓缓消失。演播室观众在此停顿中发出 "oooh"。
13-16s：一次缓慢推近 Mila 的面部，近正面特写，嘴部清晰可见。她的表情垮下来，鼓起脸颊，仍然面向他，带着被冒犯的戏剧性语气说道："I knew it."
16-18s：切到固定中景双人镜头，两人的面部均可见。直到此刻 Mila 才抱起双臂，抬起下巴噘嘴，Alex 僵住并露出尴尬的笑容。演播室观众爆发出哄笑与掌声。

audio：清晰的英语对白，自然的嗓音并带有喜剧节奏，现场演播室观众的笑声仅出现在台词之间的停顿中，任何台词之上不得有笑声或杂音，每句台词都干净独立，柔和室内环境音，无音乐。
style：明亮的 1990s–2000s 电视网情景喜剧风格，高调暖色布光，35mm 镜头，平滑缓慢推近，真实的皮肤与织物质感，对说话者面部保持锐利对焦。
constraints：保留身份特征，保留服装，卷发器始终留在 Mila 头上，面部与嘴部始终可见，无可读文字，无 logo，无水印，无额外角色，画面中不出现观众。

Seedance 2.5 提示词
创作一段 30 秒、16:9 的照片级真实感真…

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 30-second, 16:9 photorealistic live-action blockbuster sequence, set in Times Square, New York, in bright midday sunlight. The tone combines terrifying scale, brutal giant wrestling and the director's completely deadpan composure. Follow the complete story through the final spoken line. Timestamps are choreography targets.

REFERENCE LOCK
Image 1 = THE DIRECTOR, the normal human form: preserve the reference face, short curly hair, trimmed beard, black eyeglasses, dark checked three-piece suit, black shirt, tie and leather shoes.
Image 2 = his transformed HERO, exactly 700 meters tall: preserve the asymmetric red, white and blue horned oni armor, demon-face shoulders and belt, thick rope, hanging cloth and armored feet. His own right side is predominantly white/blue; his own left side is predominantly red. Never mirror this arrangement. Empty hands; no added weapons.
Image 3 = GORGON, exactly 700 meters tall: preserve the massive volcanic-rock body, horns, spikes, long armored tail, molten orange fissures and circular glowing chest core.
The director and HERO are the same individual in two forms. Exactly one HERO and one GORGON. Never exchange their designs. Use the sheets only for appearance; never show their panels, labels, studio backgrounds or turnaround poses.
VISUAL AND CAMERA RULES
Live-action photography with photoreal VFX: real skin, woven suit fabric, scratched metal, heavy stone, liquid lava, refractive heat shimmer, dense smoke, real glass and natural sunlight. Maintain sharp material detail and hard midday shadows. No illustrated or animated rendering.
Both giants remain 700 meters tall. Keep real buildings, street grids, tiny cars and windows visible as scale references. Use wide skyline compositions for throws and impacts; close-ups alone must not erase the scale.
Action-movie camerawork continues every second throughout the entire video.
Use motivated tracking, low angles, crane rises, whip-pans, aerial moves and restrained pushes during the director's calm moments. The second-by-second beats do not require a cut every second. Preserve screen direction and readable contact before each reaction. Fast superhuman movement with enormous weight, finite travel paths and violent deceleration. No prolonged slow motion.
Show the journey west from Times Square to the Hudson, then the return east. No unexplained teleportation. Effects must not conceal the wrestling grips or decisive impacts.
SECOND-BY-SECOND ACTION AND CAMERA
00-01: Extreme close-up of a physical clapperboard reading "GORGON / TAKE 1". It snaps shut immediately. Pull back and whip-tilt as GORGON's rising horned head already appears between the buildings behind it.
01-02: Rapid crane rise reveals the 700-meter monster towering over the film set. Crew members glance between it and their monitor, smiling and continuing to work as though this were planned VFX.
02-03: Street-level lateral tracking follows GORGON's first orange fire blast. An empty yellow cab's metal body slumps and melts; a burning billboard tears loose and falls.
03-04: Track with fleeing crew and pedestrians, then arc toward the director sitting perfectly still in his chair. He calmly removes his glasses while everyone rushes past.
04-05: Controlled close push-in: he folds the glasses, places them inside his breast pocket and rises. Fire reflects across his face; his expression remains composed.
05-06: Low-angle push toward him as he quietly says, "Action." White light erupts from beneath his shoes into a vertical column.
06-07: Whip-tilt upward along the same transforming body. Human legs visibly enlarge into Image 2's armored legs; the transformation climbs through the torso to the horned head.
07-08: Pull far back as the completed 700-meter HERO drops into a massive two-foot landing. Asphalt buckles outward in concentric waves; abandoned cars bounce around his enormous feet.
08-09: Low side tracking: GORGON unleashes a sustained fire torrent. HERO crosses both forearms before his face and chest, catching the blast; flames split around the crossed armor.
09-10: Retreating chest-height camera leads HERO as he charges straight through the uninterrupted fire, forearms still crossed. Buildings slide past below his shoulders.
10-11: Swing to a clear lateral angle. HERO opens his guard and drives a devastating forearm lariat across GORGON's upper chest, knocking its feet off the ground. Show the contact clearly.
11-12: Whip-pan into a wide westward tracking shot. GORGON flies toward the Hudson waterfront, gouging a trail through the city; HERO pursues in enormous bounding strides.
12-13: Low waterfront tracking: GORGON regains its feet and meets HERO in a violent clinch. HERO's hands grip the molten torso; his gauntlets glow red and release dense smoke.
13-14: Tight moving insert on the smoking grip, then slide behind them as HERO refuses to let go, ducks around GORGON and locks both arms around its waist from behind.
14-15: Wide side view with the Hudson clearly visible. HERO plants his feet, lifts GORGON completely off the ground and arches backward into an unmistakable German suplex.
15-16: Track the full throwing arc. GORGON's head and upper back smash into the Hudson, throwing up a colossal wall of water. HERO rolls through the motion toward his feet.
16-17: Fast lateral aerial move follows a huge steam explosion as displaced river water crashes across GORGON's molten body. Keep its falling silhouette readable through the steam.
17-18: Push through thinning vapor to a close view of the torso. Orange surface fissures rapidly darken into black rock; thermal fractures race across the armor. The chest core alone remains intensely hot.
18-19: Crane outward as HERO regains his stance, hauls the weakened GORGON out of the shattered riverfront and raises it horizontally over his head in both hands.
19-20: Wide orbit: HERO performs one fast, complete airplane-spin revolution with GORGON held crosswise overhead. Its heavy tail sweeps through the air; black crust fragments fly outward.
20-21: High tracking view follows HERO's immense eastward leap back toward Times Square while carrying GORGON. The river recedes behind them; the city visibly passes beneath.
21-22: Descending wide shot: HERO turns GORGON head-down and drives it crown-first into the center of Times Square. The street collapses into a deep crater and nearby towers tilt outward.
22-23: Low crater-edge dolly: GORGON falls onto its back, exposing the cracked chest core. HERO thrusts an open palm close to it and fires a concentrated white-hot beam with a crimson edge directly into the core.
23-24: Fast pullback as the beam bores into the core. Light floods through GORGON's cracks; the core swells and ruptures into a blinding internal detonation.
24-25: Very wide aerial retreat: the fictional core blast erupts with super-nuclear visual scale. An expanding dome of light sweeps across Manhattan; skyscrapers are torn apart in successive shockwave rings.
25-26: Distant panorama moves laterally as a towering mushroom cloud rises over the devastated skyline. Push toward the epicenter through clearing blast haze, revealing only HERO's upright silhouette.
26-27: The colossal silhouette visibly contracts inside a narrowing shaft of light, restoring the human director in the same dark suit. Whip down to a toppled production camera, its red tally light still on.
27-28: Ground-level dolly past that still-recording camera follows the director taking one step to his scorched, overturned chair. He calmly sets the chair upright amid drifting ash.
28-29: A gentle low-angle push follows him sitting down, retrieving the glasses from the same breast pocket and putting them back on.
29-30: Continue the restrained push to his deadpan face against the ruined city. He says clearly, "Cut. Print it." End immediately on his composed expression.
AUDIO
No BGM, score, song or musical stingers. Diegetic sound only: clapper snap, distant traffic, fleeing footsteps, fire roar, liquefying metal, falling signage, armor friction, colossal footfalls, lariat impact, rock fractures, water impact, violent steam hiss, beam discharge, the core explosion and settling debris.
The only intelligible speech is the director's quiet "Action." and final "Cut. Print it." Use the same low, controlled voice for both. Reduce surrounding effects enough to hear these lines. No narrator, crowd dialogue or extra catchphrases.
EXCLUSIONS
No anime, cartoon, cel shading, comic panels, game-render appearance, toy-scale buildings, plastic armor, miniature aesthetics, character redesigns, duplicate giants, extra limbs or unexplained size changes. No subtitles, captions, title cards, watermarks or added logos. The clapperboard text is an in-scene prop, not an overlay. No blood, exposed wounds, dismemberment, bodies or close-ups of civilian injury. Keep the action focused on the two giants and environmental destruction. Do not omit the return to human form, the chair, the glasses or the final line.

Seedance 2.5 提示词
创作一段 30 秒、16:9 的照片级真实感真人电影大片序列，场景位于纽约时代广场，明亮正午阳光。基调结合了骇人的尺度感、残酷的巨人摔角，以及导演完全面无表情的冷静气质。跟随完整故事一直到最后一句台词。时间戳是编排目标。

参考锁定
图像 1 = 导演，正常人类形态：保留参考面部、短卷发、修整过的胡须、黑色眼镜、深色格纹三件套西装、黑衬衫、领带和皮鞋。
图像 2 = 他变身后的 HERO（英雄），身高恰好 700 米：保留不对称的红、白、蓝三色有角鬼 Armor、鬼面肩甲与腰带、粗绳、垂挂布料和装甲脚掌。他自身的右侧以白/蓝为主；自身左侧以红色为主。绝不镜像这一布局。双手空置；不添加任何武器。
图像 3 = GORGON（戈尔工），身高恰好 700 米：保留巨大的火山岩躯体、角、背刺、长装甲尾、熔融橙色裂缝和圆形发光胸腔核心。
导演和 HERO 是同一个体的两种形态。恰好一个 HERO 和一个 GORGON。绝不互换二者的设计。仅将图板用于外观；绝不展示其画板、标签、影棚背景或转台姿势。
视觉与摄影规则
真人实拍配合照片级视觉特效：真实皮肤、编织西装面料、划痕金属、厚重岩石、流动岩浆、折射热浪、浓密烟雾、真实玻璃和自然阳光。保持锐利的材质细节和正午硬阴影。不得有插画或动画渲染。
两个巨人始终保持 700 米高。保留真实建筑、街道网格、微小车辆和窗户作为尺度参照。投掷与撞击使用广阔天际线构图；单靠特写不得抹去尺度感。
动作片摄影贯穿整段视频，每一秒都在继续。
在导演的平静段落中使用有动机的跟拍、低角度、摇臂升起、甩镜、空中移动和克制的推镜。逐秒节拍并不要求每秒都切镜头。保持银幕方向，并在每次反应前呈现可读的接触。快速的超人移动带着巨大重量、有限的移动路径和剧烈减速。不得有长时间慢动作。
呈现从时代广场向西前往哈德逊河、再向东返回的旅程。不得出现无法解释的瞬移。特效不得遮挡摔角握持或决定性撞击。
逐秒动作与摄影
00-01：实体场记板的极近特写，上面写着 "GORGON / TAKE 1"。它立即啪地合拢。拉远并甩倾镜头，此时 GORGON 升起的带角头颅已经出现在其后方的楼宇之间。
01-02：快速摇臂升起揭示这头 700 米怪物高耸于片场之上。剧组成员在它与监视器之间来回张望，微笑着继续工作，仿佛这是计划内的视觉特效。
02-03：街面高度的横向跟拍追随 GORGON 的第一发橙色火焰冲击。一辆空黄色出租车的金属车身瘫塌熔化；一块燃烧的广告牌松脱坠落。
03-04：跟拍逃散的剧组人员和行人，然后弧形移向端坐不动的导演。他在众人奔逃而过时平静地摘下眼镜。
04-05：克制的近距离推入：他折好眼镜，放进胸袋，然后起身。火光映在他的脸上；他的表情依然从容。
05-06：低角度推近他，他低声说："Action."（开始。）白光从他的鞋底喷涌而出，形成一道垂直光柱。
06-07：沿同一具正在变形的身体向上甩倾。人类的双腿明显壮大为图像 2 中的装甲腿；变形自躯干向上攀升至带角的头颅。
07-08：大幅拉远，完成形态的 700 米 HERO 落下，双脚着地掀起巨大的冲击。沥青向外呈同心波纹状隆起；废弃车辆在他巨大的脚边弹跳。
08-09：低角度侧向跟拍：GORGON 释放持续不断的火焰洪流。HERO 将两条前臂交叉挡在面前和胸前，接住冲击；火焰从交叉的装甲两侧分开。
09-10：后退的胸高机位引领 HERO，他前臂仍交叉，直冲穿过不间断的火焰。楼宇从他肩膀下方掠过。
10-11：摇镜至清晰的侧面角度。HERO 打开防御，以一记毁灭性的前臂横臂扫击轰在 GORGON 上胸，将其双脚击离地面。清晰呈现接触。
11-12：甩镜进入向西的广角跟拍镜头。GORGON 飞向哈德逊河滨，在城市中犁出一道深痕；HERO 以巨大的跳跃步伐追击。
12-13：河滨低角度跟拍：GORGON 重新站稳，与 HERO 陷入激烈的贴身缠斗。HERO 的双手抓住熔融的躯干；他的护手发出红光并释放浓密烟雾。
13-14：紧贴移动的插入镜头对准冒烟的握持点，然后滑到他们身后，HERO 拒绝松手，绕到 GORGON 下方，从背后双臂锁住其腰部。
14-15：侧面广角画面，哈德逊河清晰可见。HERO 双脚扎稳，将 GORGON 完全举离地面，向后弓身完成一个无可置疑的德国背摔。
15-16：跟拍完整的抛掷弧线。GORGON 的头部和上背砸进哈德逊河，激起一道巨墙般的水柱。HERO 顺着动作翻滚至双脚着地。
16-17：快速的横向空中移动跟随着一场巨大的蒸汽爆炸，被 displaced 的河水冲刷过 GORGON 熔融的躯体。让它坠落的身影在蒸汽中保持可辨。
17-18：穿过逐渐稀薄的蒸汽推近躯干。橙色的表面裂缝迅速暗化成黑色岩石；热裂纹在装甲上急速蔓延。唯有胸腔核心依然炽热。
18-19：摇臂向外拉开，HERO 重新站稳，从破碎的河滨把虚弱的 GORGON 拖出，双手将其水平举过头顶。
19-20：广角环绕：HERO 抱着横置的 GORGON 高速完成一次完整的空中旋转（airplane-spin）一周。它沉重的尾巴扫过空气；黑色结壳碎片向外飞散。
20-21：高空跟拍视角追随 HERO 抱着 GORGON 向东跃回时代广场的宏大跳跃。河流在他们身后退去；城市在下方明显掠过。
21-22：下降的广角镜头：HERO 将 GORGON 转为头朝下，把它以头顶为尖端砸进时代广场中心。街道塌陷成深坑，附近的塔楼向外倾斜。
22-23：坑沿低角度推轨：GORGON 仰面倒下，露出开裂的胸腔核心。HERO 将张开的手掌逼近核心，射出一道边缘带着绯红的高集中白热光束，直接击入核心。
23-24：光束钻入核心时快速拉远。光芒从 GORGON 的裂缝中涌出；核心膨胀并在一场刺眼的内部爆炸中破裂。
24-25：极广角空中退后：这次虚构的核心爆炸以超核武的视觉尺度爆发。扩张的光之穹顶扫过曼哈顿；摩天大楼在接连的冲击波环中被撕碎。
25-26：远景全景横向移动，一朵高耸的蘑菇云在满目疮痍的天际线上升起。穿过逐渐散去的爆炸烟尘推向爆心，只显露出 HERO 直立的剪影。
26-27：巨大的剪影在一道收窄的光柱中明显收缩，恢复为身着同一身深色西装的真人导演。甩镜下摇至一台被撞倒的摄影机，其红色 tally 灯仍然亮着。
27-28：地面高度推轨掠过那台仍在录制的摄影机，跟随导演走一步到被烧焦、翻倒的椅子旁。他平静地把椅子扶正在飘散的灰烬中。
28-29：柔和的低角度推镜跟随他坐下，从同一个胸袋里取出眼镜并重新戴上。
29-30：继续克制的推镜，落到他面对废墟城市的面无表情的脸上。他清晰地说："Cut. Print it."（停。拍下来。）在他从容的表情上立即结束。
音频
无背景音乐、配乐、歌曲或音乐音效点。只用画内声：场记板拍合声、远处车流、奔逃的脚步声、火焰轰鸣、金属熔化、招牌坠落、装甲摩擦、巨型脚步、横臂扫击撞击、岩石断裂、水体撞击、剧烈蒸汽嘶鸣、光束喷射、核心爆炸以及落石余响。
唯一可辨识的台词是导演轻声说的 "Action."（开始。）和最后的 "Cut. Print it."（停。拍下来。）两句都要用同样低沉克制的嗓音。降低周围音效以保证能听清这两句台词。不要旁白、人群对白或额外的口号。
排除项
不要动漫、卡通、赛璐璐上色、漫画分格、游戏渲染外观、玩具比例建筑、塑料装甲、微缩感观感、角色重新设计、重复巨人、多余肢体或无法解释的体型变化。不要字幕、说明文字、标题卡、水印或添加的标识。场记板上的文字是场景内道具，不是叠加层。不要血液、暴露的伤口、肢解、尸体或平民受伤的特写。动作应聚焦于两个巨人与环境破坏。不得省略变回人类形态、椅子、眼镜或最后一句台词。

Action movie camera work continues every 1 second.

Cinematic live-action in a bright modern airport terminal, the camera angle stays the same as the reference image throughout: same eye-level framing, same position, with fast tracking shots following the action. The reference image is the opening frame: a woman with a lilac bob and thin gold glasses, in a navy blazer and skirt, balancing on one leg with a navy stiletto in her hand, four men in dark suits behind her. The four men close in on her from behind. With her hands she pulls off the first shoe, then the second, one at a time, and stands barefoot in black pantyhose on the grey carpet. She turns and throws the shoes hard at the nearest man's face. The shoes strike him square in the face, his head snaps back and he staggers, stunned. Only then does the fight start: she fights all four in fast, fluid choreography: a high spinning kick, a sharp palm strike, her hair whipping across her face, the attackers falling one by one. Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 30-second, 16:9 photorealistic supernatural action film. A fictional grand museum in New York City, deep at night: a vast Greek sculpture gallery, tall marble columns, glass exhibits, blue moonlight through a skylight, Manhattan lights beyond upper windows. Start inside the gallery with immediate movement. Use readable silhouettes, physical weight, sharp impacts and detailed debris.

Action-movie camerawork continues every second throughout the entire video.
Each one-second beat below has active, motivated camerawork. Beats may connect within continuous shots; do not force a cut every second. Maintain clear geography, show contact before destruction, and preserve the full ending.

REFERENCE ROLES
Image 1: KAIROS, the adult Black male protagonist before transformation. Preserve his face, braided dreadlock bun, sunglasses, black long coat and mechanical limbs.
Image 2: the SAME protagonist after mechanical transformation, wearing the black-and-crimson SKULL LORD armor: horned helmet, skull motifs, red core, layered plates and red hanging fabric. He is the hero, never a separate enemy. Telescoping machinery increases his height from approximately 1.9 m to the reference's 3.3 m. His eyes become completely covered by a sealed opaque visor.
Weapon exception: use a Japanese katana with a clean, mirror-polished blade and black-and-red hilt, replacing the sword pictured in Image 2. Keep this same katana throughout.
Image 3: SERPENT ORACLE, the antagonist. Preserve her adult female appearance, ivory layered robes, extensive cloth coverage, red ancient markings, gold serpent ornaments and black-and-gold snake hair. Her ordinary eyes stay bandaged. Only the forehead binding loosens for the third-eye reveal.

Use the sheets for appearance only. Preserve identities, clothing, materials and colors. Do not reproduce their grids, labels or diagrams. Statues are her petrified human victims, now solid marble throughout. The guards remain intact stone figures at the entrance, outside the main combat area.

STORY RULES
Her snake eyes channel the initial petrification curse while her human eyes remain covered. Her forehead third eye releases the final concentrated curse. Establish one consistent fictional rule: a mirror-polished blade can return that curse to its source.
The hero never exposes his eyes after transformation. His armored optical system reads only her image reflected in the katana during the final maneuver; convey this through the visor-and-blade composition, without HUD graphics.

TIMELINE
00-01: Extreme macro tracking along the woman's wrapped forehead inside the central glass case. Red ancient symbols ignite one after another; a snake shifts beneath a binding. Pull focus to a crack racing across the glass.
01-02: The case bursts outward and all snake heads rise together. A fast backward dolly reveals three approaching guards with raised flashlights; glass sweeps past the lens.
02-03: Whip from a snake's opening eye to the guards. Their faces, hands and uniforms turn gray stone in a fraction of a second. They freeze in their flashlight-aiming poses; the lights remain on.
03-04: Match-cut from a newly petrified guard's terrified face to an ancient marble figure with the same trapped terror. A lateral push reveals its eyes moving and stone fingers grinding against its pedestal.
04-05: A rising diagonal move reveals the gallery's statues stepping down together. Their frightened human expressions and stone-covered personal ornaments reveal the people trapped inside these forms.
05-06: Tilt sharply toward the moonlit skylight. KAIROS crashes downward through it, his recognizable face and braids briefly clear against distant Manhattan lights.
06-07: Floor-level tracking follows his feet into a heavy crouched landing. Boots strike first, knees absorb the impact, marble cracks and glass skitters outward. Hold physical contact clearly.
07-08: A low three-quarter push follows mechanical transformation from the planted boots upward: actuators telescope, limbs lengthen and black-and-red plates unfold and lock. No dissolve or unexplained costume swap.
08-09: Continue rising to the chest core and skull armor. The horned helmet closes around his head; the opaque visor snaps fully shut over both eyes. Red core light reflects on falling glass.
09-10: Track along the katana as he draws it. Its mirror finish briefly reflects the veiled woman behind him, planting the final trick. He immediately slices an approaching marble figure; the visible impact breaks it into stone.
10-11: Lateral tracking: he ducks a second statue's punch and cuts upward through its solid marble torso. Angular fragments scatter across the floor, with dry dust and no organic material.
11-12: A low forward drive follows his shoulder-check into a third statue. It flies into a column, fractures on impact and knocks a large section from the column.
12-13: Follow the falling column section as he vaults over it. He lands into a downward strike that shatters a fourth statue and chips the floor beneath it.
13-14: Side-on tracking keeps the cause and result in frame: he kicks a broken pedestal into two advancing statues, driving them through glass display cases.
14-15: Sweep around his sword side as he pivots through a waist-height slash. Three tightly grouped marble attackers break apart in sequence along the blade's path.
15-16: A close rear tracking shot catches another statue grabbing his cloak. He breaks its stone hand with an elbow, turns and drives the sword hilt into its chest, cracking it apart.
16-17: Track the last charging statue across the central aisle. His diagonal cut sends its two stone sections into an already damaged column, collapsing the column into the empty side gallery.
17-18: Pull back through settling rubble to reveal the woman beginning to float above her broken case. The hero pivots toward her; the ruined hall remains visible between them.
18-19: Crane upward beside the floating woman. Her layered robes billow as eight principal hair-snakes extend 20-30 meters across the vast hall, retaining the reference's patterned scales.
19-20: Track one enormous snake striking toward the hero. He dashes sideways; the head smashes the exact floor position he occupied, spraying marble chips.
20-21: A ground-skimming lateral move follows him sliding under two crossing snakes. Their bodies strike opposing columns and tear through more display cases behind him.
21-22: Pull wide as snakes coil around tall columns and wrench them apart. The hero springs over a falling beam while another snake lunges through the opening beneath his boots.
22-23: Track his controlled landing onto a clear strip of floor. He deliberately turns his back toward the woman as her snakes recoil for a final attack. The camera continues moving over his shoulder.
23-24: Push toward her forehead. Only its bandage unwinds; her ordinary eyes remain covered. A closed third eye begins to open beneath the glowing red symbol.
24-25: Track beside the hero's sealed visor. With his back still toward her, he raises the polished katana near his face, slightly offset beside his head. Her veiled face and opening third eye are clearly reflected in the blade.
25-26: Move to a readable side angle showing woman, blade and hero. The third eye opens and sends a narrow supernatural light past his shoulder onto the angled blade; the blade visibly reflects it back into her third eye.
26-27: Push toward her as gray stone rapidly spreads from her forehead across her face, robes and snake hair. Show her entire form become solid marble before the strike. The extended snakes stiffen and stop.
27-28: A fast waist-height arc follows the hero turning through one precise horizontal slash. The blade cuts across her already petrified torso, leaving a clean fracture. His visor remains completely closed.
28-29: Glide past her stone face as hairline cracks spread through the figure and its petrified snakes. She drops gently onto the broken plinth and begins crumbling into dry marble fragments.
29-30: A low forward glide follows her gold serpent medallion falling onto the floor. Her entire stone figure finishes collapsing into an inert rubble mound in the background. One delicate metal clink ends the scene; the armored hero stands beyond the settling dust.

AUDIO
BGM enabled: an original tense cinematic score. Sparse low strings and pulsing bass during the awakening; driving percussion enters with the landing and transformation, accelerating through the battle. Drop the percussion when he raises the reflective blade. Cut the score at the reflected curse's impact and keep it absent through the quiet final collapse.
Use spacious museum ambience, distant NYC traffic, glass bursts, servo locks, heavy footsteps, metallic sword sounds, grinding marble, columns breaking, snake hisses, falling stone and the final medallion clink. Keep decisive effects audible over the music. No dialogue, narration or vocals.

CONSTRAINTS
No subtitles, captions, speech bubbles, title cards, logos or watermarks. Keep the requested ancient symbols as physical markings on the bandages and robes. No blood, gore or exposed tissue; destroyed figures are solid stone. Preserve the woman's layered clothing. No extra protagonist, identity swapping, exposed hero eyes, teleporting transformation, constant slow motion, camera roll, obscuring impact flashes or explosion at the ending. Make the petrification, mechanical transformation, reflection and final collapse understandable visually even without sound.

Seedance 2.5 提示词

动作片的摄影运镜贯穿整部视频，每一秒都在持续进行。
下面每一秒的节拍都配有主动且动机合理的运镜。节拍可以在连续镜头中衔接；不要强行每秒都切一个镜头。保持清晰的空间地理关系，先呈现接触再呈现破坏，并完整保留结尾。

参考角色

图片 2：同一位主角在机械变形后的状态，身穿黑红配色的 SKULL LORD 铠甲：带角头盔、骷髅纹样、红色核心、层叠甲片和垂挂的红布。他是英雄，绝非另设的敌人。伸缩机械结构将他的身高从约 1.9 m 提升至参考图中的 3.3 m。他的双眼被完全遮蔽，由密封的不透明面罩覆盖。

图片 3：SERPENT ORACLE，反派。保留其成年女性外貌、象牙白层叠长袍、 extensive 的布料覆盖、红色古老符文、金色蛇形装饰和黑金蛇发。她的普通眼睛始终被绷带遮住。仅额头处的绑带松开，用于第三只眼的揭示。

她的蛇眼引导最初的石化诅咒，而她的人类眼睛始终被遮住。她额头的第三只眼释放最后凝聚的诅咒。确立一条一致的虚构规则：镜面抛光的刀刃能把该诅咒反弹回其源头。
变形后英雄绝不暴露双眼。在最后一招中，他铠甲化的光学系统只能读取武士刀上反射出的她的影像；通过面罩与刀刃的构图来传达这一点，不要使用 HUD 图形。

人类客人无恙撤离。所有对立角色全部为无人操控的机器，配有金属装甲、伺服机构与发光部件。它们的失败通过设备损坏、失去动力以及奇幻式化为扑克牌粒子来表现。
